answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, rewards vest against future work. What survives to the hollow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A delta of per-task receipts records who did what, and the jetty of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
